{{Quote|The ''Jedi Council'' recently learned ''Clan Besaddii [sic]'' has been secretly funnelling the casino's profits to the ''Separatists''.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], to [[Kanto Raka]]|<ref name="Prof">{{TCWComicCite|6.12|The Professional!}}</ref>}}
'''Besadii''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan. They were the bitter enemies of the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] clan. An [[Slavery/Legends|anti-slavery]] raid shut down their [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesian]] slave operations. The Raid was instituted by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] force lead by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Bria Tharen]]. Before this raid, Besadii was a profitable [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] was one of their main markets. After the [[Battle of Nal Hutta]], many members of the Besadii were killed in their palaces by [[Yuuzhan Vong]] creations. The surviving members evacuated to [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]].

Prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the more notorious Hutts of the Besadii clan were: [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Elder]] and [[Arok/Legends|Arok]], the latter leading and representing the clan on the [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Hutt Ruling Council]]. Gardulla would often be seen as the mighty and more successful [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] main rival, but would also be of service to him; for example, she was his representive during [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure's]] trial.
